item.title: Tippecanoe Valley to Honor Gene Hughes for 50 Years of Dedicated Service
item.description: Tippecanoe Valley School Corporation will hold a special recognition ceremony honoring Mr. Gene Hughes for an extraordinary 50 years of commitment, leadership, and service to TVSC athletics on Saturday, Jan. 31, prior to the 5 p.m. girls' varsity basketball game against Wawasee.

item.title: Tractor Driver Flown To Fort Wayne After Accident Involving Train North Of Claypool
item.description: A person was flown to a Fort Wayne hospital after their tractor was hit by a train north of Claypool.

item.title: Indiana Senate Approves Bill To Finance NFL Stadium With Eye On Chicago Bears
item.description: Just as quickly as the idea to move the Chicago Bears team to northwest Indiana came to light in a surprise open letter from the team's president, Indiana state lawmakers got busy drafting the infrastructure to make it happen.

item.title: Bowl For Kids’ Sake Is Back For 2026
item.description: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Northeast Indiana will host its annual Bowl For Kids’ Sake fundraiser in Kosciusko County from 1-3 p.m. and 4-6 p.m. Saturday, March 7 and 2-4 p.m. Sunday, March 8 at The Bowling Alley, 1535 N. Detroit St., Warsaw.

item.title: Indiana Lawmakers Remove Nitrogen Hypoxia From Execution Bill
item.description: A bill expanding Indiana’s execution methods was significantly amended Tuesday, Jan. 27 after lawmakers voted to remove nitrogen hypoxia as an option and added provisions on media access and mental health support.
